what: Diagnosed why athena check --history rejects 64ecdc9 after two rejected fix jobs: it is a parentless commit (a second root on main) that Athena's own commit path wrote during job 20261010-132713-ezm8; the old gate accepted it, the new records-based landing check does not.
why: Athena's agents work in snapshots without git history, so neither attempt could inspect the commit, and both were rejected for not finding the cause; I looked at the history myself to break the loop.
